scope: Separate motor-off crash/abort presentation; no original controller commands execute after handoff and no controller safety guarantee is transferred.
model_semantics: Recorded mass/inertia and aerodynamic parameters are frozen at handoff; prescribed wind and obstacle positions may vary. Obstacle free-joint poses AND world velocities are imposed from the absolute-time trajectory at every step. A large finite drive mass approximates an externally driven environment; the solver sees moving surfaces, but obstacle impact response is reset each step. This external trajectory drive can supply work and is not a closed isolated system.

obstacle_drive.velocity_rule: piecewise-linear center derivative; right derivative at knots

collider_semantics: cf21B XML sphere geometry by default; separate from any older centered point-model ego envelope.
state_semantics: position/world velocity; xyzw body-to-world quaternion; body-frame angular velocity
integration: MuJoCo implicitfast, explicit 1-step mj_step calls; drone qpos/qvel assigned only once at handoff
obstacle_motion: Piecewise-linear interpolation of archived absolute-time obstacle-center samples; no trajectory is extrapolated beyond the source recording.
